==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=OfficeIMO&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/OfficeIMOTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=OfficeIMO&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using OfficeIMO.Word;
using OfficeIMO.Excel;
using OfficeIMO.PowerPoint;

// Verify.OfficeIMO: Verifies Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, PDF, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, email and more through OfficeIMO: text, a csv per sheet, a deterministic copy and page renders.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.OfficeIMO
// Note: Streams and files are matched by extension: docx, xlsx, pptx, vsdx, pdf, xps, odt, ods,
// odp, rtf, epub, eml, msg, mht, one, mpp, pub, djvu, pages, numbers, key, accdb and mdb.
// Note: Images are rendered by OfficeIMO, with no Office install needed. OpenDocument and RTF have
// no png.
// Note: A png is rendered with the installed fonts, and Office's default font Aptos is installed
// only with Office. Add the fonts the documents use to VerifyOfficeIMO.Fonts so a build server
// renders the same png.
// Note: Open XML SDK documents are opt in, via VerifyOfficeIMO.RegisterOpenXml(), since
// Verify.OpenXml converts the same types.
// Note: Targets net10.0 only.
public class OfficeIMOTests
{
    // A WordDocument writes an info file of its properties, the text of every paragraph,
    // a deterministic docx, and a png per page rendered by OfficeIMO itself.
    [Fact]
    public Task Word()
    {
        using var document = WordDocument.Create();
        document.AddParagraph("Hello World");
        document.AddParagraph("Second paragraph");
        return Verify(document);
    }

    // A workbook writes a csv and a png per sheet, so a changed cell shows up as a one line diff.
    [Fact]
    public Task Excel()
    {
        using var document = ExcelDocument.Create();
        var sheet = document.AddWorksheet("Data");
        sheet.CellValue(1, 1, "ID");
        sheet.CellValue(1, 2, "Name");
        sheet.CellValue(2, 1, 1);
        sheet.CellValue(2, 2, "Jane Smith");
        return Verify(document);
    }

    // A presentation writes the text of each slide, with its notes, and a png per slide.
    [Fact]
    public Task PowerPoint()
    {
        using var presentation = PowerPointPresentation.Create();
        presentation.AddSlide();
        return Verify(presentation);
    }

    // Rendering is the slow part, and a png depends on the fonts installed. This skips it;
    // the info, text and deterministic copy still verify.
    [Fact]
    public Task ExcludePng()
    {
        using var document = WordDocument.Create();
        document.AddParagraph("Hello World");
        return Verify(document)
            .ExcludeDerivedTargets("png");
    }

    // A file or stream with any extension OfficeIMO reads is loaded and verified the same way.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.docx in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.docx in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task DocxFile()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.docx");
    }
}
